name: another ONE
source:
Short story collection based on ONE visual novel. Stories depict feelings of girls after Kouhei Orihara leaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一部以视觉小说《ONE》为基础的短篇故事集，描写折原浩平离开后，女孩们的心情。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
